rows.scope: Represent ratios and percents with concrete models, fractions, and decimals.
Represent benchmark fractions and percents using 10-by-10 grids, strip diagrams, number lines, and numbers; 1%, 10%, 25%, and 33 1/3% are illustrative examples marked 'such as'.
Generate equivalent fractions, decimals, and percents in real-world problems; monetary contexts are included and must be preserved.
Convert units within a measurement system, including proportional and unit-rate methods.
Use scale factors, tables, graphs, and proportions to represent mathematical and contextual ratios/rates.
Solve the three part/whole/percent unknown cases in real-world problems, including concrete and pictorial models.
Use equivalent fractions, decimals, and percents to represent equal parts of the same whole.
